_note: Three sections. active_checks[] = the SUMMARIZED, deduped live project overlay /critique reads before every review (the ADD direction — checks the Critic was MISSING). calibration_notes[] = the LIGHTEN direction (Phase 4.1 / Theme 5): per-project signals that a model-on-model dimension/gate has been low-signal here (low precision / quiet over a window); /critique + /code-review read them to weight that dimension lighter — INFORM, never disable. HARD RULE: only critique/critique-review/code-review (+ project active_checks) may be lightened; the reality spine risk-spike/validate-slice is NEVER lightened. runs[] = append-only audit history of every /critic-calibrate run; a new run NEVER overwrites a prior one. /critic-calibrate upserts accepted ADD proposals into active_checks, confirmed LIGHTEN proposals into calibration_notes (or retires a noisy active_check), and appends the run to runs. agents/critique.md (the plugin base Critic) is NEVER edited from a project.

active_checks.check: Check auth/authz on every new API endpoint and mutation path.

calibration_notes.note: Over-engineering findings were FALSE-ALARM 4/5 times here (this project already runs lean) — weight this dimension lighter on low-tier slices; do NOT inflate. Advisory only; never a reality sign-off.

proposals.text: Lighten the Over-engineering dimension (FALSE-ALARM 4/5 over 15 slices).
